The '''Corellian Run''' was one of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|largest]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] running through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], mapped between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[24,000 BBY]]. It contributed in making [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] an economic superpower. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] held substantial power in the sectors around it.

When the [[Kyyr system]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] obsoleted the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the spaceports along the Run overshadowed [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], which thrived up until then.

==Description==
With the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], it formed [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] region of the Galaxy which was explored and populated easier and faster than other parts.

The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] part of the Corellian Run consisted one of the three sides of the infamous [[Spice Triangle/Legends|Spice Triangle]] (with the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] and the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]]).<ref name="TEA" />

===Course===
It began at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], going around the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] while passing through [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]], [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]], [[Kailor V]], [[Xorth]], [[Vuma/Legends|Vuma]], [[Leria Kerlsil]], [[Perma]], [[Lolnar]], [[Rehemsa]], the [[Sedratis system/Legends|Sedratis system]] and [[Rydonni Prime]], to reach [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] branched off. From Corellia, it proceeded to [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]], its final stop in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] before it traversed the other major regions of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />

It also ran near [[Goorla]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and [[Monor II|Monor]], [[Paqwepor]], [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]]<ref name="g10">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref>

In the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] it passed through [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar]], [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]], [[Pencael IV]] and [[Havricus]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] it passed through [[Iseno/Legends|Iseno]], [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] (where it crossed with the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]) and [[Spirana/Legends|Spirana]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] it passed through [[77 Sectors|77 subsectors]], which included [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]], [[Tlactehon]], [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]], [[Gamor system/Legends|Gamor]], [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]] and [[Thaereian system|Thaere]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] it passed through [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]], [[Doldur]], [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], [[Kabray]], [[Algara II]], [[Andosha II]], [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] and [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]], as well as [[Habassa II/Legends|Habassa]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the Outer Rim it passed through [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]], [[Gorno]], [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon]], [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Wrea/Legends|Wrea]] and [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]], as well as near [[Shimia/Legends|Shimia]]. It ended near the distant [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] worlds of [[Naos system/Legends|Naos]] and [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].<ref name="TEA" />

A branch of the Corellian Run, in its outer reaches, went near the [[Lamaro system]]. When the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] settled [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], they took steps so that this ramification stopped being widely used.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>
